title: WebSec Probe Surface
description: Deterministic candidate rows from the four shipped probes, per axis: sites (raw pre-discriminator hits), rows (post-discriminator candidates), emitted, tail, blind keys and quota bookkeeping. Rows are obligations to look, never claims; the surface is stamped with the index_sha it was derived from so a stale surface can be detected.

parse_version.description: the index parse version this surface required

index_sha.description: content hash of the structural index the rows were derived from

axes.description: one entry per registered probe: the four-state surface that makes closure non-vacuous

sites.description: raw hits before the shape discriminator

wanted.description: min(per_axis, rows) before the total ceiling

floor.description: min(floor, rows): the reserved quota the ceiling may not trim

rows.description: emitted candidates, ranked (tier, -assertion_gap, siblings, name) within their axis; probe-specific fields are the disposition anchor enum for that probe

test_double.description: the sibling's source is test scaffolding (a mock|mocks|test|tests|harness|fixtures path, or a Mock*.sol / *Mock.sol / *.t.sol filename); the rank key counts NON-test-double siblings only and the collapsed representative prefers a non-test-double site

own_form.description: assertion-strength rows only, and only when the caller builds the surface with ProbeOpts.SentinelForm (the shipped surface does): the consumer's own strongest guard for the row's concept key is a SENTINEL check — `!= 0`, `!= bytes32(0)`, `!= address(0)`, `> 0`, `.length > 0`. Such a check cannot express the truth of the value it guards: any non-zero lie passes it, so 'an assertion exists' is not an answer for this pair. Absent means only that no sentinel guard was found, never that the row is answered.

own_guard_text.description: assertion-strength rows only, present exactly with own_form="sentinel": the consumer's own guard condition for the concept key, verbatim from the structural index (the reference's own-guard class is this guard's class).

stages_unguarded.description: IMPROVEMENTS C1: the (write, read) enforcement stage pairs of this row's concept keys that no assertion about the key covers, scoped to this row's contract and derived deterministically from the structural index. Present only when at least one such pair exists; capped, with stages_unguarded_total carrying the true count.

write_guarded.description: the write site's function carries an assertion about the concept key

read_guarded.description: the read site's function carries an assertion about the concept key

stages_unguarded_total.description: the true number of uncovered stage pairs for this row, before the stages_unguarded cap

family.description: IMPROVEMENTS C2: the inheritance family (union-find over the index's inherits edges) whose members disagree about this custody primitive. Present only on the family-divergence rows added when the surface is built with ProbeOpts.Symmetry.

direction.description: IMPROVEMENTS C2: the custody direction the divergent site serves, read off the function name (drop wins over withdrawal, which wins over recover, which wins over deposit).

asset.description: IMPROVEMENTS C2: the asset class the divergent site moves — native for a value send, share for the contract's own mint/burn, erc20 for a token call on another contract.

divergence.description: IMPROVEMENTS C2: member-disagreement (two members of one family use different primitives for the same direction and asset) or funding-mismatch (a forward path mints/burns while a recovery path moves the asset out of a balance it never held).

expected.description: IMPROVEMENTS C2: the primitive the sibling (expected) side performs.

expected_asset.description: IMPROVEMENTS C2: the asset class the expected side moves (it may differ from the moved asset, e.g. a burn of the member's own share against an erc20 payout).

observed.description: IMPROVEMENTS C2: the primitive the divergent (observed) side performs.

base_function.description: IMPROVEMENTS C2: the function of the expected side, paired with base/base_line.

members.description: IMPROVEMENTS C2: the family's member contract names, so the row can be read as a family statement.

missing.description: axes whose quota was trimmed by the campaign ceiling: emitted < min(per_axis, rows). A silent 14th-place eviction is not a disposition

warnings.description: operator-visible arithmetic problems with the quota knobs themselves, e.g. the reserved per-axis floors exceeding --total (the ceiling can never trim below the reserve). Additive: a surface written before this key existed still validates
